text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I can't stop thinking about this limited-time "Become Number One! Super Stamina Beef Bowl."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I mean, it has "number one" in its name! It's a match made in heaven!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But… it is a lot of food. It might be too heavy to eat right before a race…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But, but! I can't pass up on first place! Me, of all people!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Argh! I don't know what to do!
choice_data_list: The race should be your number one priority! Stay strong!
Eat like a champion and become number one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're right! Being number one on the track comes before any beef bowl!
choice_data_list: We can have it to celebrate your win.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I like your style! It'll be the first thing I do!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Y-you're right! I'll eat it and just burn it off! And if it helps me win, then even better!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That settles it. Let's see if this will really make me number one!
